title: Solving 2D Black Scholes Equation via Hermitian Block Embedding and Generalised Quantum Signal Processing
summary: The Black Scholes equation provides a fundamental model for the no arbitrage pricing of financial derivatives. After finite difference discretisation, the pricing problem can be formulated as a finite dimensional linear algebra problem involving the inverse of a non Hermitian time step matrix. Recent advances in quantum linear algebra algorithms, particularly the generalised quantum signal processing (GQSP)algorithm, enable matrix functions to be implemented through polynomial transformations of a suitable unitary or Hermitian form.
